'''April 2001 Meriden tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held at DJ's Comics, Meriden, Connecticut on 14 April 2001. [[Mike Van Zander]] won it. It is known from R. Smith's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2099">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-17-wrong-fluid-meriden-ct-4-14-2k1d2099/ wrong-fluid-meriden-ct-4-14-2k1], DeckTech (R. "Voice of Law" Smith, 17 April 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-17-wrong-fluid-meriden-ct-4-14-2k1d2099/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 14 April 2001
* '''Site:''' DJ's Comics, Meriden, Connecticut
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Players:''' 14
* '''Winner:''' [[Mike Van Zander]]
